metadata.question: Did the Indus Basin aquifer region centered at coordinates 31.998723, 73.931617 (within a 10km radius) experience significant groundwater decline between 2003 and 2013?

data.raw_code: The user asks about groundwater decline in the Indus Basin between 2003-2013 using coordinates (31.998723, 73.931617) with 10km radius. Key considerations: 1. GRACE satellites (Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment) measure groundwater changes via gravity anomalies 2. Need to use GRACE data products available in GEE 3. Should compare average groundwater storage anomalies for 2003 vs 2013 4. Need to handle potential data gaps (GRACE launched in 2002, so 2003 should have data) Available GRACE datasets in GEE: - GRACE/GRACE-FO Mascon: 'GRACE/GRACE-FO/MASCON/CRI/GRID_RL06_V2' - GRACE Tellus: 'NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/MASCON' I'll use the MASCON product which has 'lwe_thickness' (equivalent water thickness in cm). Strategy: 1. Create 10km buffer around point 2. Get GRACE data for 2003 and 2013 (full years) 3. Compute mean groundwater storage anomaly for each year 4. Compare if 2013 < 2003 by significant threshold (e.g., >5cm decline) 5. Handle data availability issues Note: GRACE data is monthly, so I'll average all months in each year. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([73.931617, 31.998723]); const region = point.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer const start2003 = '2003-01-01'; const end2003 = '2003-12-31'; const start2013 = '2013-01-01'; const end2013 = '2013-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GRACE MASCON product const grace = ee.ImageCollection('GRACE/GRACE-FO/MASCON/CRI/GRID_RL06_V2') .select('lwe_thickness'); // equivalent water thickness in cm const grace2003 = grace.filterDate(start2003, end2003); const grace2013 = grace.filterDate(start2013, end2013); // Check collection sizes const count2003 = grace2003.size().getInfo(); const count2013 = grace2013.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2003 Images: ${count2003}, 2013 Images: ${count2013}`); if (count2003 === 0 || count2013 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Compute annual means const mean2003 = grace2003.mean(); const mean2013 = grace2013.mean(); // 4. Get pixel counts to check for valid data const countReducer = ee.Reducer.count(); const countPixels2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: countReducer, geometry: region, scale: 50000, // GRACE resolution ~300km, using 50km scale maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const countPixels2013 = mean2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: countReducer, geometry: region, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 2003: ${countPixels2003}, 2013: ${countPixels2013}`); if (countPixels2003 === 0 || countPixels2013 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate mean groundwater values const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(); const gw2003 = mean2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: region, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); const gw2013 = mean2013.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: region, scale: 50000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lwe_thickness').getInfo(); console.log(`GW 2003: ${gw2003?.toFixed(2)} cm, GW 2013: ${gw2013?.toFixed(2)} cm`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (gw2003 === null || gw2013 === null || isNaN(gw2003) || isNaN(gw2013) || Math.abs(gw2003) > 1000 || Math.abs(gw2013) > 1000) { // Sanity check console.log("C3"); return; } const difference = gw2013 - gw2003; console.log(`Difference (2013-2003): ${difference?.toFixed(2)} cm`); // Significant decline threshold: >5cm decline (negative difference) if (difference < -5) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
